message.content:
Use Playwright or browser automation to access the IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO) database at https://www.imf.org/external/datamapper/ and extract:
1. Real GDP level (constant prices) for Georgia from 2000-2027
2. Real GDP growth rate from 2000-2027

You'll need to:
- Navigate to the IMF data mapper
- Search for Georgia
- Select the variable "Real GDP (constant prices, National currency)" and "Real GDP growth"
- Extract the data for years 2000-2027
- Return the data in a structured format (year, real GDP level, growth rate)
